title: Silky Eggplant and Sunflower Dip
description: Covered braising gives peeled eggplant a soft texture that blends with sunflower seed paste and sweet paprika.
equipment: Immersion blender and tall heatproof jug

ingredients.name: peeled fresh eggplant
ingredients.note: Weigh the flesh after peeling and cut into small cubes.

steps.title: Braise the eggplant
steps.text: Combine {eggplant}, {broth}, {garlic} and {paprika} in the HexClad. Cover and simmer for 12–16 minutes, stirring twice, until the eggplant collapses under a spoon.

steps.title: Concentrate the base
steps.text: Uncover and stir over medium heat for 2–4 minutes until the eggplant is very soft and the remaining liquid lightly coats the pan.

steps.title: Blend the sunflower dip
steps.text: Blend the eggplant and all its juices with {sunflower} and {vinegar} until soft and spoonable.

steps.title: Adjust the consistency
steps.text: Scrape all of the mixture into the measuring cup. Add cold water a teaspoon at a time if needed to reach about 1 1/2 cups, maintaining a smooth spoonable texture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool in a shallow covered container, then serve chilled with soft vegetables or swirl a spoonful through warm rice.

notes: Yield: About 1 1/2 cups. One serving is 1/4 cup. Make ahead: Braise the eggplant a day ahead. Keep the cooking juices for blending. Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze for up to 2 months and blend briefly after thawing to redistribute the seed oil. Fridge reheat: Serve chilled. Stir until smooth just before portioning. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw covered in the refrigerator, then whisk or blend briefly and serve cold. Option A includes vinegar and garlic. For gentler Option B, omit the vinegar and halve the garlic. The dip is dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 51 kcal, 1.9 g protein, 4.4 g total carbohydrate, 3.4 g fat, 2.1 g fiber, 3 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal.
